data.disagreement_analysis: The disagreement was caused by an HTTP 400 API error in the qwen model, which resulted in an inconclusive verdict, rather than a difference in security analysis.
coverage_issues: qwen model failed to review any files due to LLM API request failures (HTTP 400).
learnings: Implement retry logic or fallback mechanisms for LLM API errors (like HTTP 400) to prevent entire audits from failing when a single request fails.
